lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Eight distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is wider in the mid-section (approx. 100-120 pixels) and narrows significantly toward the posterior flank (approx. 40-60 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and fourth stripes from the anterior terminate at the mid-lateral torso line; the eighth stripe is a shortened segment restricted to the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 4 faint white spots is visible on the upper posterior hind limb near the tail base.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a sharp lateral divergence followed by a medial convergence; the vector from base to tip forms a complex spiral trajectory.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tips account for approximately 12% of the total vertical horn height.

other_distinctive_markers: White dorsal crest of hair extending along the spine; white chevron marking on the snout; white spots on the cheek; high-contrast white throat patch and carpal/tarsal banding.
